That package.json diff predates my changes (already modified before I started, per initial git status). The tsconfig.json reformatting was auto-applied by `next build`/`next dev` — harmless and expected on Next 16. Everything looks good.

## Summary

Migrated the project from Pages Router to App Router:
- Created `app/layout.tsx` (root layout with `<html>`/`<body>` and shared metadata previously in `_document.tsx`/`_app.tsx`)
- Created `app/page.tsx` (was `pages/index.tsx`) and `app/about/page.tsx` (was `pages/about.tsx`), converting `next/head` tags to the `metadata` export
- Removed `pages/` entirely (`_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`, `index.tsx`, `about.tsx`)
- Verified `npm run build` succeeds and both `/` and `/about` render correctly (right titles, meta description, content, and nav links) via `next start`

No functionality or UI changed — same markup, same links, same page content.
